question: Indian Standard Time (IST) is ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__5 hours 30 minutes__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Standard Time (IST):**

 
 
• **It is 5 hours 30 minutes ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)**. **Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• In India, the** longitude of 82.5****°**** E is treated as the Standard Meridian**.
 
• The Indian Standard Time is calculated from **82°30’E meridian passing through Mirzapur.**
 
• The local time at the meridian is taken as the Standard Time for the whole country.
 
• It is known as the** Indian Standard Time (IST).**
 
• The **Prime Meridian is a 0****°**** and is known as the Greenwich line as it passes through Greenwich near London**, where the British Royal Observatory is located.
 
• **Longitudes** have one very important function i.e. they **determine Local Time in relation to Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)**.
 
• Local Time is the time reckoned by **the noon-sun at a given place and Standard Time is the Local Time of the Standard Meridian of a country**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)**

 
 
• **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT), **the name for the **mean solar time of the longitude (0°) of the Royal Greenwich Observatory in England.**
 
• The **meridian at this longitude** is called the **prime meridian or Greenwich meridian.**
